sections.Profile:
The Knock Out pinball machine, designed by Harry Mabs and released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in December 1950, is a one-player electro-mechanical game themed around boxing. Known for its mechanical animation, the playfield features two boxers and a referee in a miniature boxing ring.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1950
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Wood Rail, Sports, Boxing, Playfield Gimmick
